package handlers

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/filters"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/queryfields"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/transport/http/api/v1/middleware"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/task"
)

type publicTaskFieldsRepo struct{ fields []queryfields.Set }

func (r *publicTaskFieldsRepo) Create(context.Context, domain.Task) error { return nil }
func (r *publicTaskFieldsRepo) Update(context.Context, domain.Task) error { return nil }
func (r *publicTaskFieldsRepo) Delete(context.Context, string) error      { return nil }
func (r *publicTaskFieldsRepo) Get(context.Context, string) (*domain.Task, error) {
	return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
}
func (r *publicTaskFieldsRepo) GetWithFields(context.Context, string, queryfields.Set) (map[string]any, error) {
	return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
}
func (r *publicTaskFieldsRepo) ListByLesson(context.Context, string) ([]domain.Task, error) {
	return nil, nil
}
func (r *publicTaskFieldsRepo) ListByLessonFields(_ context.Context, _ string, f queryfields.Set, _ filters.TaskFilters, _ *filters.SortOptions) ([]map[string]any, int, error) {
	r.fields = append(r.fields, f)
	item := map[string]any{"id": "task-id", "title": "Task"}
	if f.Has("assessment_purpose") {
		item["assessment_purpose"] = "diagnostic"
	}
	return []map[string]any{item}, 1, nil
}

func TestPublicTaskListNeverSelectsAssessmentPurpose(t *testing.T) {
	repo := &publicTaskFieldsRepo{}
	handler := TaskHandler{ListUC: task.ListTasksByLesson{Tasks: repo}}
	router := http.NewServeMux()
	router.HandleFunc("/task/list", handler.List)
	for _, query := range []string{"", "&fields=assessment_purpose"} {
		req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/task/list?lesson_id=11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"+query, nil)
		req.Header.Set("X-User-ID", "user")
		req.Header.Set("X-User-Role", "ADMIN")
		resp := httptest.NewRecorder()
		middleware.AuthMiddleware(router).ServeHTTP(resp, req)
		if resp.Code != http.StatusOK {
			t.Fatalf("query %q status=%d", query, resp.Code)
		}
		var body map[string]any
		if err := json.Unmarshal(resp.Body.Bytes(), &body); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if len(repo.fields) == 0 || repo.fields[len(repo.fields)-1].Has("assessment_purpose") {
			t.Fatalf("public fields selected assessment purpose for %q", query)
		}
		if len(body["tasks"].([]any)) != 1 || body["tasks"].([]any)[0].(map[string]any)["assessment_purpose"] != nil {
			t.Fatalf("purpose leaked for %q: %s", query, resp.Body.String())
		}
	}
}
